description: This file defines the Manufacturer controller class for the admin interface of an OpenCart e-commerce project. It manages CRUD operations, listing, enabling/disabling, and autocomplete functionalities for Manufacturer entities within the catalog module.

classes.name: Manufacturer
classes.description: Controller class for managing manufacturers in the admin panel, including listing, creating, editing, enabling, disabling, deleting, and autocomplete features.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads the main manufacturer management page, setting up breadcrumbs, filters, and loading the manufacturer list view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Delegates to the getList controller to display the list of manufacturers.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares the list of manufacturers based on filters, sorting, and pagination, returning a view.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Prepares data for the manufacturer creation/edit form, including loading existing data, images, SEO URLs, and layouts.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving a new or existing manufacturer, performing validation and updating the database accordingly.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables selected manufacturers by setting their status to active.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables selected manufacturers by setting their status to inactive.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected manufacturers after checking for associated products.

methods.name: autocomplete
methods.description: Provides a JSON response with manufacturer suggestions matching a filter for use in autocomplete inputs.
